title: Run one Claude request
responsibility: Runs the requested Claude model, forwards public output and reports only a completed matching-model result.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.command
inputs.description: The CliCommand whose command is the Claude executable and whose args are its initial arguments; the helper spawns the executable with those args followed by -p, --verbose, --output-format stream-json, --model set to the turn's model, --permission-mode bypassPermissions and --no-session-persistence.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.turn
inputs.description: The AgentTurn for one request: model is passed as --model and must match the model Claude reports, effort adds --effort when non-empty, cwd is the process working directory, prompt goes to standard input and signal cancels the run. Access 'read-only' adds --tools Read,Glob,Grep and 'write' adds no --tools argument; onText receives public streamed text, onStatus receives the 'Waiting for resources:' notices from managedAgentTurn, and onFile receives the file_path of each Write or Edit tool use in an assistant event.

inputs.name: claudeTurn.queue
inputs.description: Optional ResourceQueueService whose run method admits the Claude run with priority coding, memoryMiB 2048 and cpus 1; when omitted, managedAgentTurn calls resourceWork with process.env instead.

outputs.name: claudeTurn
outputs.description: A promise that resolves to { text, model } after the CLI exits with code 0 and its last result event is not an error: text is that event's result as a string (empty when missing or null) and model is the model its init event reported, which equals the requested model. Public text extracted from each parsed event is forwarded to onText while it runs, and lines that are not valid JSON are ignored.

examples.text: Added the retry helper to the upload client and updated its unit test.
The function already rejects empty input, so no change was needed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Error when no system init event reports the requested model ('Claude did not run the requested model.'), or when there is no result event or its is_error flag is set (the message is its result text when present, else 'Claude returned no completed result.'). A CLI exit other than code 0, a process error event, a run longer than 600000 ms or output over 16000000 bytes also rejects with Error, and resource queue or resourceWork failures propagate unchanged unless turn.signal is aborted.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Rejects with RunCancelled when turn.signal is aborted: the CLI process is sent SIGTERM, and any error that managedAgentTurn catches after the abort is reported as RunCancelled instead.
